title: Director of Technical Services

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Agfa's Technical Services or Applications Engineering team provides technical support to sign manufacturers, print service providers, and vehicle wrap installers using their equipment. This Director owns customer satisfaction, technical troubleshooting, and application development for Agfa's UV-curable and solvent ink systems across outdoor signage, vehicle graphics, and architectural applications. They would care about Tedlar because: (1) Customer complaints about premature fading, cracking, UV degradation, or graffiti damage on outdoor graphics create support burden and escalations—recommending Tedlar as the validated overlaminate eliminates a major source of field failures; (2) Technical Services must develop and publish application guidelines, substrate compatibility matrices, and lamination specifications—establishing Tedlar as the recommended protective film simplifies their technical documentation and training; (3) They manage relationships with key customers who demand proven durability for high-profile installations (transit graphics, building wraps, fleet graphics)—Tedlar's 60+ year track record and -70°F to 230°F operating range provides the technical credibility their largest customers require; (4) This role owns application development KPIs and customer uptime metrics, both improved by reducing rework and warranty exposure through superior overlaminate performance.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This Director leads the team that provides post-sale technical support, application engineering, and troubleshooting for Agfa's large-format printer customers globally. They own the technical relationship with sign manufacturers, print service providers, and vehicle wrap installers who operate Agfa's Jeti Tauro, Anapurna Ciervo, and Onset Grizzly printers. Their scope includes developing application guidelines, substrate compatibility testing, lamination specifications, customer training materials, and field issue resolution. They influence material recommendations but do not typically purchase protective films directly—instead, they guide customer specifications and create approved vendor lists. They likely report to a VP of Customer Success or Chief Technical Officer and manage applications engineers, field service technicians, and technical support specialists across Agfa's 40+ country operations.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For Agfa's customer base, Tedlar addresses critical application challenges this Director faces daily: (1) Outdoor Signage—Sign manufacturers using Agfa UV-curable inks need overlaminates that prevent UV degradation, fading, and cracking over 10-15 year installations, reducing warranty callbacks Technical Services must manage; (2) Vehicle Wraps and Fleet Graphics—Commercial fleet customers demand graphics that survive extreme temperatures (-70°F to 230°F operating range matches Tedlar's spec), frequent washing, and road debris without premature failure; (3) Transit and Rail Graphics—High-profile transit authority projects require documented performance data and graffiti resistance (spray paint and permanent markers clean off Tedlar easily), which Technical Services must validate before spec approval; (4) Architectural Graphics and Building Wraps—Large-format architectural installations on Agfa printers need mold and mildew resistance plus UV stability for the 15-20 year building lifecycle, requiring Technical Services to certify material compatibility. Each use case reduces the support burden, field failures, and technical escalations this team handles while strengthening Agfa's solution credibility with demanding customers.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This Director is measured on customer satisfaction scores, technical support ticket resolution time, field failure rates, and major account retention. When outdoor graphics fail prematurely due to overlaminate degradation (fading, cracking, UV damage), customers contact Agfa Technical Services first—even though the printer performed correctly. These escalations consume expensive engineering resources, damage customer relationships, and create warranty exposure that reflects poorly on this leader's performance. Additionally, they're accountable for developing robust application guidelines that prevent failures before they occur, but variable overlaminate quality makes it impossible to provide consistent recommendations. Tedlar solves their core pain points: (1) Eliminates a major category of preventable field failures by providing consistent 12-20+ year outdoor performance; (2) Simplifies technical documentation—Technical Services can standardize on one validated overlaminate instead of qualifying dozens of variable-quality films; (3) Protects the Director's reputation with strategic accounts (transit authorities, architectural firms, national fleet operators) who demand proven performance data and long warranties; (4) Reduces rework and reprint costs that strain customer relationships and generate support escalations. For a technical leader at a premium equipment manufacturer like Agfa, recommending Tedlar shifts risk away from their team and toward a proven material partner with documented durability.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Agfa just completed major presence at ISA International Sign Expo 2024 (showcasing Anapurna Ciervo) and debuted three new printers at FESPA Global Print Expo 2024 alongside industry leaders. The company also won three 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards from PRINTING United Alliance, creating momentum around innovation and premium positioning. These recent product launches and industry recognition mean Technical Services is actively developing application guidelines, customer training materials, and technical specifications for new printer installations happening now. This is the ideal window to introduce Tedlar as the recommended overlaminate for these new systems, embedding it into technical documentation and sales enablement before competing materials establish themselves. Additionally, with Agfa operating globally across 40+ countries, there's year-round activity in new customer onboarding, application development, and technical support—no "off season" where outreach would be poorly timed.

personalization_hooks.hook: Technical Services teams at equipment manufacturers face support burden when customer graphics fail due to overlaminate issues, even though the printer performed correctly
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging the frustration of fielding warranty complaints about outdoor graphics degradation when the actual print quality was excellent. Frame Tedlar as eliminating this category of preventable escalations, allowing Technical Services to focus on genuine equipment optimization rather than material compatibility troubleshooting.

personalization_hooks.hook: Agfa's recent FESPA product launches and 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards create need for validated application guidelines and technical documentation for new printer installations
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their award-winning innovation and suggest now is the time to establish Tedlar as the validated overlaminate in technical specifications for new Jeti Tauro, Anapurna Ciervo, and Onset Grizzly installations. Position Tedlar as the premium material partner that matches Agfa's premium equipment positioning.

personalization_hooks.hook: High-profile transit, architectural, and fleet graphics customers demand documented performance data and graffiti resistance that standard overlaminates cannot provide
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Focus on the technical credibility Tedlar provides for enterprise RFPs and transit authority specifications. Emphasize that Technical Services can confidently commit to extreme temperature range, UV stability, and graffiti resistance with documented 60+ year track record—giving Agfa customers the technical ammunition to win competitive bids.

recommended_approach: Lead with operational efficiency—frame Tedlar as reducing Technical Services support burden by eliminating field failures caused by inferior overlaminates. Follow with technical credibility for strategic accounts, then position as simplifying application guidelines and training materials. Avoid overly salesy language; this buyer responds to engineering data, performance specifications, and documented case studies.
